description: Headless GIMP: orientation brief for the gimp_* tool surface — the headless workflow contract, curve laws (one filter per channel; re-edit by filter_id, don't stack), ledger-truth vs. readback, .xcf-vs-export, precision guidance, mask/geometry ordering, no undo for geometry, proxy-preview caveats, raw-file handling, and when to prefer gimp_* over ps_*. READ THIS FIRST when you're given an open-ended GIMP editing task. Read-only, idempotent, no document required, no GIMP round trip (returns a static markdown brief). Skip it for a trivial single-tool request where you already know which tool fits.
name: gimp_overview
